column2: Rocus... Please, protect the world. And be a help to the angel...
You are...?
Let me treat you...
No, there is no need... To wither away here is also my fate...
Why... I have these hands... and I still can't save her...
You must be one of the angel's heroes...
Don't glare at me with such a scary face. I'm one of the heroes too.
You're hurt, aren't you? I can treat you if you like.
...Really?
I'm a priest, as you can see. I can't just leave someone in trouble.
I see... Then please...
This power...?
Oh... it's nothing special.
Thank you. I owe you.
No need for thanks. I'll send the angel the bill for the offering.
Heh... You're an odd one.
So I'm told. Well, if the chance comes, we'll meet again.
Sir Mage, in trouble again, are we?
Rocus... wasn't it?
That's right. And you were Fein or some such, I believe. The angel told me before, but I can't quite recall.
I'll lend you a hand. ＄＄＄＄＄＄ wants it too.
To be saved by you so many times... I owe you one.
Well, keep up the good fight.
I'm not one for fighting, you see. I need people like you to do their best.
Understood...
This time I won't say we'll meet again. Goodbye, Sir Mage.
You're one of the angel's heroes.
...Who are you?
A priest, as you can see. As a fellow hero of the angel, I'll help you.
...There's no need.
Now, now, don't act tough. Besides, it's nothing much.
What are you going to do?
It'll only take a moment...
Your wounds should be healed.
...Thanks.
No thanks needed. ...By the way, have we met somewhere before?
No, I don't think so.
I see... My mistake, then... Oh well. We'll meet again somewhere.
Yeah. Thanks for that...
